Context: None

Question: Aren't you supposed to take your grandson to get some ice cream tonight?

Options: 
A. No because I took him last month.
B. No because I have two grandchildren
C. No because he is too fat to eat ice cream.
D. No because I don't have a grandson

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
